# Completed14 read-only metadata-pin supplier — source-only custody

Created: 2026-10-07 20:49 ET. Byte-retention archive only.

The selected R1 supplier is21,759B, SHA256 `0e8ad57fe58f631298502215732a3425ace0264e7348ecea51e6258ebf85f911`. The original a1 source is18,374B, SHA256 `53fe9ded143fe4811fd12e731ecafae51bd35758e6052b2d59096e1575fa4bbd`. Both remain **NOT RUN**. The parent accepted the R1 source, complete derivation, handoff/preparation and independent source review. That is preparation acceptance, not actual host readiness, completed metadata, export or selected-reader admission.

Exactly **nine originals /114,282B** are copied byte-exact: the two sources, original complete ee12 interface comparison, complete a1→R1 derivation, both handoffs, both unsealed source-preparation JSONs and the independent R1 review. `manifest.json` records their exact original paths/bytes/SHA and policies. Original sealed:false and absent canonical/identity fields remain untouched. Only the new archive byte-custody manifest has an explicit True seal; no original is retroactively sealed. All original source-only/NOTRUN labels and caught-defect chronology remain exact.

## Narrow correction and unchanged boundaries

Original a1 had two caught source defects and was never run: it required origin/integration equality even though primary delivery need only fetch YANMAIN, and it lacked the exact observed MemAcc wrapper upstream binding required by the future R5 invocation. R1 observes origin/integration as full40 or explicitly absent, records and rechecks it without a remote-freshness claim. R1 separately binds the literal manifest wrapper route/returned-byte SHA/Git blob and mode to the actually observed local MemAcc origin/YANMAIN40, then rechecks the observation. There is no fetch or current-MemAcc-HEAD assumption. It also requires native-B and optimize==0 before the exact reviewed ee12a returned bytes enter a unique non-main module. Original a1, original helper and all earlier source/control archives are unchanged.

At a future invocation the supplier may reuse only reviewed read-only ee12a definitions; ee12a main, fchmod, output_root, journal/private writers and correction actions are not called. Explicit deadline60..3600s, native Linuxmbit10/UID114316761, actual primary40/branch/origin bindings, exact native/source bytes and literal private-root/file/stat guards remain prerequisites. The own-source SHA is a returned before/after fact that the parent must independently compare with the selected source; it is not an invented internal selectedSHA. A finite enclosing supervision/custody allowance remains necessary, with no blocked-filesystem or duration-proof claim.

Original true-sealed all-nine completion/18 new paths/prior686/raw704/g510-ended/runner+wrapper0/full validation/empty cleanup/released-lease/source185F6 checks remain future gates. Original JSON8MiB, report1GiB and Markdown100MiB read bounds are unchanged. Future report/Markdown byte hashes are streamed twice; bodies are not parsed or transferred, YAML bodies are unopened, and report semantic identity is explicitly inherited from the original sealed acceptance. The prospective result is unsealed <=64KiB metadata only, not a replacement acceptance or science claim. No actual pins, completion values or input documents are created by this archive.

The only tracked changes are this archive and a dated claimed14 append. Both supplier/helper mains and production928/690/ee12a/R5 export/reader paths remain unexecuted. No source import, lift, compile, test, SSH, remote stage, permission/removal action, scientific CLI/Store, raw body read or numerical change occurs. C/F6,686 canonical YAMLs, library, maps/progress, other issues, earlier archives and retained ignored paths stay exact.
